text: Westport Albion’s direct, vertical passing under Grace Oduya successfully shifted momentum in their favor by increasing final third entries and field tilt to 55.8%, allowing them to control the central areas more effectively against Kingsmoor FC’s wide, crossing approach. Westport’s less aggressive pressing (PPDA 11.5) prioritized shape and quick vertical transitions rather than intense pressure, helping maintain control without forcing turnovers excessively. Coaching point: emphasize improving shot quality and finishing during these sustained attacking phases to convert possession dominance into goals.
